name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Best District Panchayat In Providing Services And Facilities To Senior Citizens
briefDescription: This national award recognizes district Panchayats for their outstanding contributions and services provided to senior citizens across India.
descriptionMd:
The "Vayoshreshtha Samman: Best District Panchayat in Providing Services and Facilities to Senior Citizens" is a prestigious national award. It is specifically designed to acknowledge and honor district Panchayats that have demonstrated exemplary dedication and success in improving the lives of senior citizens.

This award aims to encourage and highlight best practices in providing essential services and facilities, fostering a supportive environment for the elderly.
benefitsMd:
- Receipt of the prestigious "Vayoshreshtha Samman" award.
- National recognition from the Hon’ble President of India.
- Acknowledgment for outstanding work in providing services and facilities to senior citizens.
eligibilityMd:
- The award targets District Panchayats.
- District Panchayats must have done outstanding work for senior citizens.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
